Jordan (CEO): quick topline for the week — 2 min read. pls react if you need a follow-up thread. :eyes:

Jordan (CEO): 1) Launch readiness: private beta GA target still set for May 14. Current gating items: final security review, one last DSR test, and SLA page copy. Priya, Marco — can you confirm owners?

Priya (VP Eng): I own the security review follow-up. team finished 90% of findings; one outstanding KMS integration item (tracking ticket #INFR-194). ETA EOD Wed.

Marco (Head of Product): I'll own the SLA page copy + rollout comms. Draft ready, will drop in the docs channel later today for legal review.

Jordan (CEO): 2) Metrics snapshot — quick numbers we care about this week: hosted p95 latency 230ms (target <200), token spend down 6% vs last week (nice), trial-to-paid conversion steady at 2.8% (target 3.5%). Need suggestions to bump conversion.

Lena (Finance): noted on conversion. I'll work with Growth to run a pricing sensitivity quick A/B next week. if we can move to 3.2% with minimal CAC change, that hits our revenue cadence.

Jordan (CEO): 3) Reliability: saw a small regression Friday night in the routing layer — OpsBot posted an incident but automated fallback prevented user-facing error. p99 spike to 2.1s, p95 recovered after warm caches. Priya, want a short postmortem this week but make it lightweight.

OpsBot: incident created: #INC-2028 routing fallbacks triggered 2026-05-09 23:14 UTC. users affected: <1%. automatic fallback to smaller model executed. logs attached in incident channel.

Priya (VP Eng): Will do a 1-pager. root cause looks like a kernel mismatch during a canary push; rollback prevented escalation.

Jordan (CEO): 4) Cost & optimization: Redwood Optimize suggestions look promising — batching increase + small-cache TTL tweak could save ~12% on inference spend for chat-heavy workloads. Ops + Platform, prioritize a safe rollout plan.

Jordan (CEO): asks for the week:
- Priya: security item + 1p incident summary by Thu
- Marco: SLA copy + launch comms by Wed EOD
- Ops/Platform: cost rollout plan and risk checklist by next Tue
- Finance/Growth: pricing A/B plan by Mon

Jordan (CEO): misc: planning to join the customer demo with Acme on Thu 10:30 PT — please keep the keys tidy.

Priya (VP Eng): ack. I'll comment on the incident doc and post the 1p by Thu morning.

Marco (Head of Product): ack on SLA + comms. will ping legal after I post.

Lena (Finance): adding pricing A/B to Growth meeting.

Jordan (CEO): thanks team — short sync tomorrow 9:30 PT for blockers only. if nothing urgent, no standup. :pray:

Jordan (CEO): TL;DR: GA timeline unchanged, small reliability item contained, cost ops has runway for quick wins, focus on conversion and SLA copy this week.
